API ReferenceZscaler Client Connector APIPublic API ControllerUpdates profile policy rule passwords
Updates profile policy rule passwords
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zcc/papi/public/v1/managePass

Updates profile policy rule passwords. The JSON Web Token (JWT) passed in as a header must be associated with a user who has Full access to Zscaler Client Connector App Profiles with an API key created with Write access. To learn more, see Adding Roles and Adding an API Key.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
companyId
int32

Organization ID for the device.

deviceType
int32
REQUIRED

Device type can be one of the following values:

1 - iOS
2 - Android
3 - Windows
4 - macOS
5 - Linux
6 - Other
exitPass
string

Password to exit Zscaler Client Connector.

logoutPass
string

Password to log out of Zscaler Client Connector.

policyName
string
REQUIRED

Policy rule name.

uninstallPass
string

Password to uninstall Zscaler Client Connector.

zadDisablePass
string

Password to disable Zscaler Active Defense (ZAD).

zdpDisablePass
string

Password to disable Zscaler Deception.

zdxDisablePass
string

Password to disable ZDX.

ziaDisablePass
string

Password to disable ZIA.

zpaDisablePass
string

Password to disable ZPA.

Responses
​
200
400
401
403
404
429

OK

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
errorMessage
string

Response error message.
